title: Synthesis and Characterization of Novel Phenoxy-Substituted Enediyne- Triazole Conjugates Using Click Chemistry
abstract: Novel group of phenoxy-substituted enediyne-triazole conjugates were synthesized by Huisgen [3+2] cycloaddition reaction (Click chemistry) in aqueous media. It was observed that enediynes were stable in aqueous medium and open-air conditions.
